name: Shinagawa Prince Hotel
accessSummary: Shinagawa Station (Takanawa Exit) on the Shinkansen, JR lines and Keikyu Line: 2 min walk

rooms.name: Prince Hall 1 Span
rooms.note: Made up of nine spaces: Fuji, Tateyama, Daisetsu, Iwaki, Asama, Ibuki, Daisen, Ishizuchi and Kirishima. Ceiling height 5.6-7.0 m. Annex Tower 5F

rooms.name: Main Tower Medium Banquet Rooms (13 rooms)
rooms.note: 330 m² each, ceiling height 4.0-5.7 m. Moonstone, Silver, Topaz, Opal, Gold, Sapphire, Crystal, Pearl, Emerald, Diamond, Aquamarine, Ruby, Garnet. Main Tower 12F-36F (dedicated elevator)

rooms.name: Main Tower Small Banquet Rooms (11 rooms)
rooms.note: 36 m² each. Boardroom for 12. Momiji, Sumire, Shoubu, Hibiscus, Ajisai, Yamabousi, Rindou, Shakunage, Lavender, Suzuran, Kinrenka. Main Tower 3F

rooms.name: N Tower Meeting Rooms N2 and N3
rooms.note: 15 m² each. Meeting style for 8 each. 17F

rooms.name: N Tower Meeting Rooms N4 and N5
rooms.note: 60 m² each. Meeting style for 30 each. N4 is on 4F, N5 is on 5F

ops.catering: Guests are asked to refrain from bringing outside food into the N Tower rental meeting rooms (N1-N5, up to 30 people). The room fee includes a coffee service (2 cups per person), which guests brew themselves with the coffee machine in the room. (Source: Banquet Brochure, 2024 edition)
ops.restaurants: The official restaurant list shows 11 restaurants in the hotel. In the Main Tower: 39F DINING & BAR TABLE 9 TOKYO, 38F Ajikaido Gojusan-tsugi (味街道 五十三次; scheduled to close temporarily for renovation from this winter), 4F Chinese restaurant Shinagawa Taihanten (品川大飯店), 2F Coffee Lounge Mauna Kea, 1F LUXE DINING HAPUNA (buffet). In the Annex Tower: 1F Japanese bistro Ichozaka (いちょう坂; classified under "Parties & Banquets"), 2F food court Shinagawa Kitchen. In the N Tower: 1F Jojoen Shinagawa Prince Hotel branch (叙々苑). Also: SHINAGAWA PIVOT, Café & Party Garden SHINAGAWA, and Boulangerie Shinagawa. (Source: official restaurant list, in-hotel floor guide, July 2023 edition)
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet rooms on Main Tower 3F (11 rooms, 36 m² each) are described as usable also as waiting rooms for the medium banquet rooms. The Annex Tower, where Prince Hall is located, has 6 small banquet rooms (12.5-13.3 m²) with a changing room and cloakroom on 5F, and 9 banquet rooms (14.7-24.7 m²) with a changing room on 6F. (Source: Banquet Brochure, 2024 edition)
ops.loadingHours: At the load-in and load-out entrance for Prince Hall (Annex Tower 5F), the door is 3.9 m wide x 3.5 m high, and the corridor in front of the hall is 4.5 m and 5.5 m wide. The load-in elevator for the Main Tower banquet rooms has a door 0.95 m wide x 2.1 m high and a cab 2.25 m wide x 2.16 m deep x 2.98 m high. (Source: Banquet Brochure, 2024 edition)
ops.parking: Parking on site is on B1 and B2, and in the outdoor lot on Annex Tower 7F. Standard rate: 500 yen per 30 min (maximum 3,000 yen for the day). For banquet use, free for up to 4 hours, then 500 yen per 30 min. For overnight guests, 1,500 yen per night (24 hours, 1 vehicle); free for up to 3 hours with a total of 5,000 yen or more spent at in-hotel facilities. There are no parking tickets; the license plate is read on entry, and payment is made at the payment machine beside the facility entrance/exit by holding up the service coupon received at the facility (there is no payment machine at the parking exit). Reservations cannot be made, and the official site advises, "Parking space is limited, so please use trains or buses." (Source: Parking Fee Payment Guide PDF, official access page and FAQ, in-hotel floor guide, July 2023 edition)
